title: mail-server: unify blob-read backend methods
description: Found in JMAP-u6c5. MailBackend::read_blob, MdnBackend::get_blob_bytes and SieveBackend::get_sieve_blob all return the bytes of a blob by id. They are separate traits (none is a supertrait of the others), so a shared name would make calls on MemoryBackend ambiguous; that is why JMAP-u6c5 named the new one read_blob. Decide whether to hoist one blob read into a common supertrait and delete the others (breaking).
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
